title: Exercise 5.18 · Tangent curvature certifies the least eigenvalue
source_anchor: Boumal, §5.5, Exercise 5.18, with the half-normalized Example 5.17 setup; printed p. 96 / PDF p. 112
target_statement: For a real symmetric operator on a finite-dimensional Euclidean space, restrict the half-normalized quadratic to the unit sphere with its induced metric. If the sphere gradient at a unit point x is zero and the induced Hessian is positive semidefinite on every tangent direction there, then x minimizes the restriction globally and is a nonzero eigenvector at the least eigenvalue of the operator.
